text:
mira: kicking off config-only deploy: routing.timeout 1600ms -> 1250ms, batch.max_items 40 -> 28, tenant_surge_limit 250 -> 200. Canary plan: 1% for 15m, then 10% for 20m. No model change.

deploy-bot: queued cfg-20260401-3. Canary start at 12:09 UTC.

dan: noted. I'll watch p50/p95 and error budget dashboards. If p95 > +20% or errors +0.3% absolute, we rollback.

lex: are we adjusting client SDK guidance? Some SDKs have hardwired 1.2s timeouts. Might need a short advisory.

mira: good catch. Not changing SDKs in this deploy. Will open a doc and ping devex. Keep canary small until we confirm.

opsbot: created docs task DEVEX-118: "SDK timeout advisory for routing-timeout config rollout".

deploy-bot: canary progressed to 1% -> 5% at 10m per policy.

dan: seeing a slight bump in 99th for a couple of hosts only, investigating whether it's client-side timeouts or kvcache thrash.

lex: I can run a targeted synthetic against those hosts. Also adding tenant-exempt flag to the change so internal test tenants get the config early.

mira: go ahead, label is set: internal:testers. If synthetic OK and no errors, widen to 10% after 20m.

deploy-bot: warming to 10% now. Telemetry stream: /deploys/cfg-20260401-3/metrics.

dan: kvcache hitrate dropped ~3% briefly then recovered. No customer-facing errors. p50 stable, p95 +8% on the affected hosts.

lex: synthetic runs show increased latency for long-context requests. Could be batching interaction with shorter timeouts.

mira: decision: pause at 10% to debug the long-context path. Do not proceed to 50% until we confirm SDK guidance or adjust batch.window.

deploy-bot: rollout paused by request of mira. Current traffic: 10%.

opsbot: added a note to the release notes: "Paused at 10% due to p95 variance on long-context routes. SDK guidance pending."

dan: adding explicit rollback triggers in the thread: p50 > +25% or kvcache delta >7% sustained 5m or error rate increase >0.25% => immediate rollback.

lex: i'll test batch.window 20ms -> 30ms on a small internal tenant to see if that stabilizes long-context tail. Will report in 30m.

mira: thanks. If no resolution in 2 hours, we plan to revert cfg-20260401-3. We'll keep the canary pinned to current model and config. :thumbsup:
